changelog: v0.6.7: New in-game Settings menu (built by Colin; verified, merged and published by Sparky). Five tabs: Controls (look/ADS sensitivity, invert Y, bindings), Audio (master/music/SFX/menu volumes), Display (FOV, quality, vsync, fullscreen), Mobile (touch sensitivity, button opacity, vibration), and Forge AI — the DeepSeek key entry now lives in Settings (main menu + pause, masked, save/remove), fixing the unreachable key entry on Windows. Settings apply immediately and persist; reset keeps your key and bindings. Menus use native touch-to-mouse emulation per Colin's ruling; the tap-can-never-fire safety was re-proven 23/23 (runtime toggling + deploy-first gameplay mode + menu binding-erase). Web build updated too.
